description: Parse CSV/TSV data and infer each column's data type (integer, float, boolean, ISO 8601 date, or string) by classifying every non-empty value and finding the tightest type that fits them all: all-integer values infer as integer, a mix of integers and decimals infers as float, and anything that doesn't fit a narrower type falls back to string. Empty cells mark a column nullable but don't affect its inferred type.

csv.description: CSV/TSV data to infer column types from

hasHeader.description: Whether the first row is a header

name: infer_csv_column_types
